title: Asymmetry
summary: ASYM'METRY, noun [Gr. priv. symmetry, of with, and to measure.] The want of proportion between the parts of a thing. It is also used in mathematics for incommensurability, when between two quantities

inlines.v: ASYM'METRY, noun [Gr. priv. symmetry, of with, and to measure.] The want of proportion between the parts of a thing. It is also used in mathematics for incommensurability, when between two quantities there is no common measure.
